scenes.description: Toto the turtle walks slowly through a soft green garden, greeting friendly butterflies.
scenes.setting: A bright, gentle garden with soft grass, friendly trees, and a warm sky.

scenes.description: Toto spots a beautiful colorful flower blooming nearby, its red, yellow, and blue petals sparkling in the sun.
scenes.setting: Same garden, close-up on the colorful flower with vibrant petals.

scenes.description: Toto gently touches the flower and smiles, as it softly opens and releases a warm glow.
scenes.setting: Garden in soft evening light, cozy and calm.
